latest.title: Enterprise facilitators adopt Leadership Card Game for live leadership drills
latest.description: Organizations running builder academies and leadership circles today can adopt Leadership Card Game as a live facilitation format for short, high-intensity leadership drills that fit inside existing meetings—not outside them. Unlike multi-day offsites that fade by Monday, Leadership Card Game is designed for in-room rehearsal: each participant holds three cards, speaks under time pressure, and practices side-effect honesty when a choice creates operational or trust cost.

latest.title: STUDENT-DAILY-TASK-MANAGER
latest.description:
* For my first project using AWS, I decided to build a simple Student Task Manager.

     * As students, we usually have different assignments, lab works, tests, projects, and other activities to complete. Sometimes it is easy to forget a task or its deadline.

     * So, I thought of creating a simple task manager where all the tasks could be kept in one place.

     * The main goal was not to create a complicated application. I wanted to build something simple that actually solves a small problem.
